name: Gritera Security
delivery_note: The company describes its own advisers as the ones doing the work, and names them on the service pages.
specialty: Information security advisory house: security governance and GRC, identity and access management, technical security, and crisis management.
security_staff_note: In-house security staff: 31 or more. Guarded estimate by the list maintainer, not published by the company: the headcount this entity filed with Enhetsregisteret, whose registered purpose is information security services only, so the whole payroll is security work.

sources.note: Publishes service lines for governance, risk and compliance with ISO 27001, DORA and NIS2, identity and access management with Zero Trust models, technical security, and crisis management with ISO 22301
Describes Gritera Security as the group's information security practice
Registered purpose: services related to information security, including IT governance and cyber security
In-house security staff: 31 or more. Guarded estimate by the list maintainer; not published by the company.

notes: Part of the Gritera group, alongside Gritera Advisory, Analytics and Quality; this is the entity that sells the security work, which is what makes its registry headcount usable as a guarded estimate.
